understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by matching the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to each goal, then stepping onto the matching goal cell.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed one direction per turn; walls block movement but still consume stamina. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles change the corresponding carried-piece attributes, with rotation modifiers turning it 90° clockwise. A goal activates only when all three attributes match. Stamina decreases with actions, and depletion costs a life and resets stamina; losing all lives ends the game.
